statement: ∀ (θ φ : ℝ), (↑(sin θ * cos φ) + ↑(sin θ * sin φ) * Complex.I) ^ 3 = ↑(sin θ) ^ 3 * Complex.exp (3 * ↑φ * Complex.I)
